title: arabis muralis subsp. collina
intro: Arabis muralis subsp. collina, commonly known as Mountain Rockcress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and skin diseases. The therapeutic actions of Arabis muralis subsp. collina include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
